title: 3D Dango Totem
description: Changes the Totem of Undying to the Dango of Undying
body:
### Replaces the Totem with the Dango of Undying
# ![Dango of Undying in inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03b5ffc92538130d9a65e876fa7967a476ed2a9c.png)
3D Dango Totem replaces the Totem of Undying with a 3D model of dango. This pack also changes the Totem pop sound, and renames the Totem of Undying to "**Dango of Undying**"
